reminder.subject: Your next lesson is ready
reminder.heading: Ready for today’s lesson, {name}?
reminder.why: You get this because you turned on the daily reminder.
reminder.off: Turn off the daily reminder email

goal.subject: One short lesson finishes today’s goal
goal.heading: One lesson finishes today’s goal
goal.next: The next one takes {minutes}, and makes {streak}.
goal.reviewBody: A quick review also counts toward your goal.
goal.note: This is today’s reminder at {time}. When your goal is still open and you have a streak of 3 days or more, it says so. Still one reminder email a day at most.
goal.why: You get this because you turned on the daily reminder.
goal.off: Turn off the daily reminder email

welcome.subject: Welcome to UXGate, {name}
welcome.preheader: Your starting path is {path}. Unit 1 is free.
welcome.heading: Welcome, {name}
welcome.body: Every lesson is a few real decisions, with feedback that explains why. Most take 5 to 10 minutes.
welcome.note: Your daily reminder is set for {time}. You can change it in Settings.
welcome.why: You get this once, when you create an account.

badge.subject: Your badge turned gold
badge.heading: Your badge turned gold
badge.body: You got this skill right again in review, on a new case. It now counts as Kept.
badge.why: You get this because badge and certificate emails are on.

deleted.subject: Your UXGate account is set to be deleted
deleted.heading: Your account is set to be deleted
deleted.body: We signed you out on every device. Your personal data, progress and certificates will be removed by {date}.
deleted.note: Sign in before {date} to undo. After that date, the account can’t come back.
deleted.safety: Didn’t ask for this? Sign in now, change your password and write to support@uxgate.org.

unsub.title: Turn off {kind}?
unsub.lead: Other emails and your in-app notifications stay as they are. You can turn it back on any time in Settings, Notifications.
unsub.doneLead: We turned off {kind}. You can turn it back on any time in Settings, Notifications.
unsub.badLead: Open Settings, Notifications, to choose which emails you get.
unsub.errorLead: It isn’t something you did. Try again in a moment.

kinds.answer: emails about answers to your review requests
kinds.news: news and updates emails from UXGate

trial.reminderPreheader: Pick a plan to keep every unit, mastery round and certificate.
trial.reminderBody: You have Pro until then. To keep it after that, pick a plan. Nothing is charged unless you do, and your progress is kept either way.
trial.endedSubject: Your UXGate Pro trial has ended
trial.endedPreheader: Your progress is kept. Unit 1 of every path stays free.
trial.endedBody: Everything you did is kept: your XP, streak, skills and certificates. Unit 1 of every path stays free. Pick a plan any time to open the rest again.
trial.why: You get this because you started a free trial of UXGate Pro.

auth4.signupLead: Unit 1 of every path is free. No card needed.
auth4.signinLead: Sign in to pick up where you left off.
auth4.terms1: By creating an account you agree to the
auth4.eNeedEmail: Enter your email first. Then we can send the link.
auth4.eTaken: This email already has an account. Sign in instead, or reset your password if you forgot it.
auth4.eShortHas: Use at least 8 characters. This one has {n}.
auth4.eWrong: That email and password don't match. Try again, or reset your password.
auth4.eSame: Choose a password that is different from your current one.
auth4.linkBody: A sign-in link works once, for 1 hour. Send yourself a new one, or sign in with your password below.
auth4.tooManyBody: To keep your account safe, signing in with a password is paused for 15 minutes. You can reset your password now, or use an email link.
auth4.rateBody: Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth4.unconfirmedBody: Open the link we sent when you signed up, or send yourself a sign-in link.
auth4.genericBody: It isn’t something you did. Try again in a moment.
auth4.fLead: Enter the email you signed up with. We’ll send a link to set a new password.
auth4.fNote: Signed up with Apple or Google? Use that button on the sign-in page. There’s no password to reset.
auth4.resetLinkBody: A reset link works once, for 1 hour. Enter your email to get a new one.
auth4.sLead: We sent a sign-in link to
auth4.sLeadReset: We sent a reset link to
auth4.sLeadSignup: We sent a link to confirm your account to
auth4.sOnce: The link works once, for 1 hour.
auth4.sSpam: Not there? Check spam or promotions.
auth4.rLead: Choose a new password for your UXGate account.
auth4.rExpiredBody: A reset link works once, for 1 hour. Ask for a new one, and open it on this device.
